index_name: Verify-All Test Index (batch sha256 integrity-check fixture)

plugins.name: HelloDino
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Same sample plug-in as plugin-index/index.json's hellodino entry, with no sha256 at all - Marketplace::VerifyAll must report it as NoHashToCheck once installed, not silently skip it or fail.

plugins.name: MeshTools
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Same sample plug-in as plugin-index/index.json's meshtools entry, but with a sha256 that deliberately does not match the built library, so Marketplace::VerifyAll reports a mismatch for it once installed, alongside hellodino's NoHashToCheck result in the same batch.

plugins.name: CurveTools
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Never installed by the verify-all script - proves VerifyAll only reports on entries actually installed via the marketplace, leaving an uninstalled entry out of the batch entirely rather than reporting it as NotInstalled.
